line: Acer Predator Helios Neo 18 AI (2025, PHN18-72)
config_name: Predator Helios Neo 18 AI — Ultra 9 275HX / RTX 5070 Ti 12GB, 16GB DDR5, 1TB SSD, 18" WQXGA IPS 240Hz (+ bundled 1TB drive/dock set)

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop 12GB GDDR7 (Advanced Optimus)

price.notes: BBY CA verified 2026-11-24: reg $5,879, sale $4,099. Marketplace DOCK-BUNDLE SET (laptop + 1TB drive/dock) — bundle inflates the listed reg price; compare laptop-alone pricing (twin 16GB/1TB non-bundle sells for ~$3,000 on sale at sku 20126058-class). Marketplace fulfillment/return risk.

offers.name: Acer Predator Neo 18 AI 18" 240Hz Gaming Laptop,Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX,GeForce RTX 5070 Ti,16GB RAM,1TB SSD+1TB Dock Set,4-Zone Backlit Keyboard,Win 11,Black

reviews.quote: Aggregated scoring places it at around 76% overall, indicating a solid but not flawless package.

reviews.outlet: Tom's Guide (sibling Neo 16 AI, same 5070 Ti/275HX)
reviews.quote: An ineffective cooling system, slow SSD hampered by bloatware, bulky design, and short battery life make the Neo 16 AI a hard sell.

professional.note: No dedicated pro review of the PHN18-72 Neo 18 AI; anchored from NBC-reviewed PHN16-73 (same CPU/GPU). Honest null for this exact config.

praises: 18" 240Hz canvas + full 12GB RTX 5070 Ti + 24-core 275HX — the sweet-spot Neo GPU with the biggest screen
Big chassis keeps the 5070 Ti at full TGP with better acoustics than the 16"
USB4/TB4 + Wi-Fi 7 + RJ-45; four-panel-friendly deck with numpad
RAM and storage upgradeable — cheap path to 32/64GB
Bundle adds a free 1TB drive/dock on top of an aggressive sale discount
complaints: 16GB RAM is under-spec'd for this tier; first upgrade should be day one
Bundle's "regal" price is inflated — the laptop alone discounts harder elsewhere
Matte IPS panel is average; OLED Neo 16 beats it for media
Acer bloatware/PredatorSense friction and short battery (line-wide complaints)

design_philosophy: The Neo 18 AI is the big-brother of the reviewed Neo 16: identical enthusiast value stack (top Arrow Lake-HX CPU, 5070 Ti) stretched to an 18-inch desktop-replacement chassis. This 16GB tier is the bundle-set entry point — Acer/retailer packaging to move the base RAM tier with accessories attached.
rating_notes: Inferred from NBC 76% PHN16-73 5070 Ti anchor per SHARED-predator.md: 18" deltas (screen_size +1.5, portability -1.5, thermals +0.5), 16GB penalty (productivity -0.8, ai_ml -0.6), matte-IPS display deltas vs OLED anchor. Dock-bundle caveat in price.notes. No dedicated pro review — honest null.
